sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु भरतो भरद्वाजेन धार्मिक: ।उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा वाक्यं वचनकोविद: ॥ २.९२.१९॥
transliteration: evamuktastu bharato bharadvājena dhārmika: ।uvāca prāñjalirbhūtvā vākyaṁ vacanakovida: ॥ 2.92.19॥

translations.english: Thus asked by the sagacious Bharadwaja, Bharata, proficient in speech, replied with palms folded in reverence:
